title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1126 | 感恩节火鸡、蜂鸟破纪录、海胆里的蛤蜊
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🦃 感恩节特赦：火鸡“自由”和“羽毛”获得总统赦免，羽毛还跑进了灌木丛！
🐦 一只小蜂鸟三十八天飞了四千多英里，从阿拉巴马飞到阿拉斯加，创下新纪录！
🐚 深海新发现：一种小蛤蜊居然住在海胆的喉咙里，科学家都惊呆了！

📖 Word of the day: pardon（赦免；原谅）

🎮 二选一：当一只被赦免的火鸡、整天在大学吃苹果，还是当一只小蜂鸟、飞四千英里去阿拉斯加？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🦃 Two turkeys named Freedom and Feathers got a Thanksgiving pardon, and Feathers ran into the bushes!
🐦 A tiny hummingbird flew four thousand fifty five miles from Alabama to Alaska in thirty eight days, a brand new record!
🐚 Scientists found a brand new clam living inside the throat of a sea urchin!

📖 Word of the day: pardon

🎮 Would you rather be a pardoned turkey eating apples, or a tiny hummingbird flying four thousand miles to Alaska?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. pardon（赦免；原谅）
To pardon means to forgive someone and let them go free.
例：The turkeys got a pardon!（火鸡们得到了赦免！）

2. gobble（咯咯叫；狼吞虎咽）
Gobble is the funny sound a turkey makes. It also means to eat very fast.
例：The turkey goes gobble, gobble!（火鸡咯咯叫！）

3. tracker（追踪器）
A tracker is a tiny device that tells you where something is.
例：Scientists watched the bird with a tiny tracker.（科学家用一个小小的追踪器观察这只小鸟。）

4. throat（喉咙）
Your throat is the tube inside your neck that food goes down.
例：The little clam lives inside the sea urchin's throat.（小蛤蜊住在海胆的喉咙里。）
